concern_summary: This concern addresses the checks and updates needed for distance requests, determining whether a transaction qualifies as a distance request and managing associated display actions.
This concern encompasses functionalities related to preparing and sending updates to distance requests, ensuring that transaction details are accurately reflected in the system.

This concern relates to the comprehensive management and creation of distance requests, including validation of waypoints and transaction details, as well as handling navigation through the request process.
This concern deals with calculating and managing navigation distances based on the current state of routing and navigation events.
This concern covers the creation and management of distance-related expenses, as well as the drafting processes related to such expenses.
This concern encompasses functionalities related to calculating distances and their associated monetary amounts, including taxable amounts based on distance measurements and specific rates.

This concern deals with retrieving and updating distance rates associated with specific units, ensuring the correct application of those rates in transactions, including validations based on policy specifications.
This concern focuses on updating and managing tax rates related to distance measurements, handling various states of success and failure for tax claimability.
This concern involves processing and displaying waypoints that are associated with distance transactions, including their descriptions and visual identification.
